description.text: Discover masterpieces by artists from Monet to Renoir on this 2 to 2.5-hour small-group tour of Paris’ renowned Musée d'Orsay (Orsay Museum). With numbers limited to just six people, you’ll enjoy personal attention from your guide as you learn about the birth of impressionism, discover the unique techniques of Van Gogh and Cezanne, and see exquisite artworks by Manet, Degas, Gauguin and many more. Stops include Musée d'Orsay, Rhinoceros by Alfred Jacquemart. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Paris landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Musée d'Orsay, Rhinoceros by Alfred Jacquemart that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
